fact: On 10 September 2025 the African Union Commission reported that Liberia's Ministry of Education completed a peer review and policy dialogue on 1-5 September 2025 on its Education Management Information System, signed an EMIS Validation Report, and adopted a costed three-year modernisation plan including unique learner and teacher IDs and annual staff training, noting the last school census was in 2021.
title: Liberia Launches Roadmap for Strengthened and Modernized Education Data Systems
